messages.subject: new guide system
parts:
Dear list members

Now I'm developing a new guide system (currently called legend) of ggplot2.
A major modification is that the system supports any type of guide,
not limited to the legend.
Now, I wrote two guides - one is the legend that is currently
available, and another is a colorbar guide.
You can see some examples of colorbar here:
http://kohske.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/alpha-version-of-colorbar-legend-in-ggplot2/
But please note that the example script and the direction of
installation is out dated.

I have already written basic features of these gudes and base guiding system,
but as it is under development, I'm happy if you give me any feedback,
bug report, feature request, etc.
As you know, I'm not a native English writer/speaker, so there should
be something strange on help file.
Please tell me if you find.

If you are interested in, please try.

How to install and how to use:

It is developed on github, so you can use hadley's devtools.
Please see: https://github.com/hadley/devtools

I strongly recommend to use dev_mode, otherwise your current
installation will be overwritten by the new one.

1. install and load devtools

2. on R console,
> dev_mode(TRUE, path-to-somewhere)
> install_github("ggplot2", "kohske", "feature/new-guides-with-gtable")
> library(ggplot2)

3. you can find help files:
> ?guides
> ?guide_legend
> ?guide_colorbar

4. you can run the example script
> library(reshape) # necessary for current example ... removed in future
> example(guides)
> example(guide_legend)
> example(guide_colorbar)


Probably the example and online help are not complete, so please feel
free to ask anything.

from Munich Airport

kohske
